audit_stage: STAGE 8.10A FINAL FORENSIC EVIDENCE AND CLAIM AUDIT
audit_objective: Audit evidence integrity of Stage 8.10A artifacts before master-handoff closure
decision_semantics_explanation: CONDITIONAL refers to the existence of an alternative D-1 00Z model-level archive that is causally available but operationally misaligned with the locked Stage 8.1 lead-time protocol (+25h..+48h vs +7h..+30h). Stage 8.10B is NOT JUSTIFIED under the locked POLARIS protocol.

corrections.previous_wording: Shifting a cloud layer vertically changes surface shortwave GHI by <1.5%
corrections.evidence_status: UNSUPPORTED NUMERICAL CLAIM (Qualitative physical intuition presented without a reproducible 1D radiative transfer simulation or paper citation)
corrections.corrected_wording: Vertical condensate profile shape represents potentially novel information relative to total-column LWP/IWP, but Stage 8.10A did not demonstrate that this information is predictively irrelevant to SW_IN. The route remains experimentally untested because the required causally aligned D-1 18Z model-level archive is unavailable.
corrections.reason: Removed uncalculated numerical claim (<1.5%) and replaced with conservative, scientifically defensible wording.

corrections.previous_wording: surface GHI is overwhelmingly governed by total column optical depth, making vertical profile shape redundant
corrections.corrected_wording: Stage 8.10A does NOT establish that vertical cloud structure has no predictive value or is physically redundant. The audit establishes only that the intended causally aligned D-1 18Z model-level archive has 0/347 empirical coverage, and the alternative D-1 00Z archive introduces a severe 18-hour lead-time penalty.
corrections.reason: Restricted claim boundary strictly to dataset availability and lead-time alignment rather than asserting physical irrelevance.

corrections.previous_wording: 347 origins x 48 lead-time steps = 16,656 files, >1.46 TB extraction burden presented as measured values
corrections.corrected_wording: 347 origins x 48 hourly forecast steps = 16,656 expected step files based on MET Norway THREDDS URL/catalog patterns. The total storage volume of >1.46 TB is an estimated theoretical calculation (347 daily runs x 65 levels x 2 variables x grid size approx 4.2 GB per run), not a direct local disk measurement.
corrections.reason: Explicitly distinguished catalog URL pattern expectations and theoretical volume estimates from local empirical disk measurements.

corrections.previous_wording: NO -- True MEPS model-level cloud condensate is NOT operationally available...
corrections.corrected_wording: True MEPS model-level cloud condensate was not demonstrated to be usable for a Stage 8.10B experiment under the locked POLARIS causal-availability and lead-time protocol because the intended D-1 18Z model-level archive has 0/347 empirical coverage. The alternative D-1 00Z archive is available but changes the information set through a materially longer forecast lead time and therefore does not constitute a clean continuation of the locked benchmark.
corrections.reason: Adopted the exact required safe scientific conclusion.
